verdict.rationale: A live probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://docs.speechischeap.com/openapi.json: it returned HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. That makes the spec directly downloadable from the official docs origin, and the agent-oriented llms.txt and markdown docs sit alongside it. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that announces or describes the spec, and confirmation that it covers all API surfaces (Jobs, Edge, x402) and stays in sync with versioned releases.
